senses.gloss: f. (sub. בית) m. a subterranean masoned store-room, cistern, cellar. [Syr. חדותא grex, horreum, P. Sm. 1200.] [In Mishnah Seder Tohăroth חדות, v. R. S. to Ohol. XI, 8.] B. Bath. IV, 2 he who sells a house, has not sold with it לא את הבור ולא את הר׳ either the pit or the duth.
units: Ib. 64ᵃ אחד הבור ואחד הד׳ וכ׳ bor and duth are subterranean, בור בחפירה ד׳ בבנין a bor is made by digging, a duth by masonry. Tosef. Erub. XI (VIII), 18; Tosef. Pes. I, 3 היציע והד׳; Y. ib. I, 27ᵇ top והחד׳. Ib. בח׳ שיש לה וכ׳ treating of a ḥadduth which has a lid.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 2:1:4">Y. Ab. Zar. II, 40ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>עולה … לחרות</he> (corr. acc.) when going up with him to the upper story or down to the cellar &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 5:6">Kel. V, 6</cite> ed. Derenb. <he>הח׳</he>. Ohol. XI, 8 <he>הח׳</he>; Tosef. ib. XII, 4 <he>הד׳</he>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>דּוּתִיּוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Bava Batra 3:1">Tosef. B. Bath. III, 1</cite> (Var. <he>דּוּתוֹת</he>, Mish.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 4:2">ib. IV, 2</cite> sing.).—<he>חַדּוּתִין</he>. Y. ib. IV, 14ᶜ bot. <he>חרותין</he> ed. Krot. (corr. acc.). [Our w. seems to be originally <he>חדות</he>, fr. <he>יחד</he>. As to rejection of <cite ref="H00000"><he>ח</he></cite> cmp. <cite ref="H00978"><he>חַלְבֵּצִין</he></cite>.]
